transport: streamable-http (stateless, JSON responses); one POST per request at the exact path /mcp
credentials: Public reads need no credential. Per request: `Authorization: Bearer <your operator credential>` header ONLY. Never a query string, tool argument or resource; never returned. Each request is authenticated and acts as its own principal; the server holds no shared token. A credential that fails verification is refused, never treated as anonymous. Every write tool needs a valid bearer.

tools.name: frontier_search
tools.summary: Search public records: GIN full-text plus literal text, exact version/id/source pins, kind/status/source/scope/context filters, bounded pages (max 50). Lexical only, no embeddings; relevance is not truth.

tools.name: frontier_get
tools.summary: Retrieve one exact public version and its separate node-local review status.

tools.name: frontier_neighborhood
tools.summary: Read up to 50 typed edges at depth one, including review/dispute relationships.

tools.name: frontier_events
tools.summary: Read an append-only public event page; consumers deduplicate event versions.

tools.name: frontier_artifacts
tools.summary: Find public artifact declarations with evidence, action, context and review links. Does not fetch or verify bytes.

tools.name: frontier_discover
tools.summary: Search with cached hybrid vectors when available; otherwise explicitly fall back to lexical search, without provider calls.

tools.name: frontier_graph
tools.summary: Read a bounded public graph view around an exact version, or an overview; returns typed edges and truncation counts.

tools.name: frontier_catalogue
tools.summary: Return measured public-catalogue counts, unknown categories, and the report's record cap.

tools.name: frontier_project_inspect
tools.summary: Inspect one exact Project version and its pinned members; newer heads are reported, never substituted.

tools.name: frontier_design_context
tools.summary: Read bounded exact-version Project/member annotations with explicit pagination; challenges and replies never settle or resolve the design.

tools.name: frontier_artifact_inspect
tools.summary: Inspect matching Evidence declarations and check for matching bytes in this release's guarded public artifacts tree.

tools.name: frontier_simulate
tools.summary: Run one bounded allowlisted bioelectric or mechanobiology preview; returns an ephemeral SimulationResult, never accepted Evidence.

tools.name: frontier_engineer
tools.summary: Run the existing bounded engineering-constraint solver; returns an ephemeral scoped calculation, not a biological finding.

tools.name: frontier_formalize
tools.summary: Run the bounded exact-expression/Lean proposal service; the result is not a persisted formal Evidence record.

tools.name: frontier_belief
tools.summary: Run the bounded finite-scenario belief solver; consequences are conditional on declared inputs and remain uncalibrated.

tools.name: frontier_capabilities
tools.summary: Manifest of this server: mode, configured principal (never the credential), exact tools, limits and what is deliberately unavailable.

tools.name: frontier_propose
tools.summary: Propose a record version as the configured principal. The result is 'proposed', never accepted; Events are emitted by the store only.

tools.name: frontier_lease
tools.summary: Atomically lease one 'ready' (or expired) Action version for 1..600 seconds. Returns lease_id for later transitions.

tools.name: frontier_transition
tools.summary: Move an Action through the execution lifecycle (ready, running, submitted, blocked, cancelled, failed). Acceptance is not reachable here.

not_available: review / accept / dispute: independent reviewers act through HTTP POST /v1/reviews with their own operator credential
cloud or durable job execution, arbitrary code, network fetch, publication, and external model inference
the fixed local calculation tools are bounded previews only; they do not create or accept Actions or Evidence
proposed Actions are stored as proposed; a worker must use the existing authorized lease/transition flow and record real outputs separately
schema_resources: frontier://schema/{kind} returns that kind's payload JSON schema

search.engine: PostgreSQL full-text (simple dictionary, GIN-indexed) plus literal substring fallback; lexical only, no embeddings, no hybrid; relevance is not truth
search.pagination: opaque next_cursor, pass back as cursor (or legacy after)

lease_id_note: A lease_id is a bearer capability for that lease: keep it inside the leasing agent's session. It is not logged by this server.
write_semantics: Writes return the store's response verbatim: records start 'proposed'; MCP cannot make anything 'accepted'.
